Project: https://github.com/sueszli/autograd.lean/

Hi everyone.
This is probably a better fit for the #new members chat :)

For my first leaning project in Lean, I built a tiny automatic differentiation engine, inspired by PyTorch-style computation graphs but with the twist of also implementing Karpathy's MicroGPT model inside of it to parity check for numerical consistency of gradients and outputs.

It's not particularly performant, but it has been a very fun exercise in thinking rigorously about autodiff and learning the language.

:sprout: :rainbow: Yahya
